in_sanskrit.name: गोपिका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who tends to cows, a cowherd girl

in_marathi.name: Gopika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of cowherd
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gopika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Gopika refers to the female counterpart of the cowherd community, who are devoted to Lord Krishna. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘gopa,’ meaning cowherd.

in_bengali.name: Gopika
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Goddess of cowherd
in_bengali.long_meaning: Gopika একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। In Hindu mythology, Gopika refers to the female counterpart of the cowherd community, who are devoted to Lord Krishna. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘gopa,’ meaning cowherd.

vedic_reference.note: Derived from the Sanskrit word गोपी (gopi), meaning 'cowherd'. In Hindu mythology, the gopis were the devoted female followers of Lord Krishna, who were known for their love and devotion towards him.
